description: A month after state regulators ordered Commonwealth Edison to pay $38 million in refunds due to the scandal tied to ex-House Speaker Michael Madigan, the Illinois attorney general wants consumers to get a little more. Illinois Attorney General Kwame Raoul on Tuesday said ComEd used “accounting tricks” that cost consumers millions of dollars when the […]

title: Attorney general seeking more money for consumers from ComEd for scandal tied to House Speaker Michael Madigan - Kwame Raoul
